Press Space or the button as each line starts. A wrong tap? Press Backspace or “Undo tap”. To redo from a line in the middle, press ◎ in the line list.
Next: —

Lyrics

  • One phrase per line. A blank line adds a short pause.
  • I remember/the dawn … / marks a cut boundary
  • *transparent* … emphasis (larger, stronger effects)
  • A trailing ! … adds a flash and shake
  • lyrics|reading or note … smaller text in annotation layouts
  • [01:23.45]Lyrics … uses an LRC timestamp
  • [interlude 8] … an 8-second instrumental part (no lyrics, background and decorations only). Without a number it lasts 4 seconds; tap sync or markers set its length
  • # starts a comment (ignored)

Audio and timing

No audio. Import a song to detect beats and align cuts.

Lines and cuts

    00:00.00/00:00.00
    Drag the line markers (top) to move line starts. Hold Shift to ignore beats
    Techniques Replace only this cut

    Each click changes the style, mood, motion, colors and arrangement. Press R to do the same.

    Change one thing

    Accent and offset colors

    Background and text colors

    The same seed produces the same arrangement. Reroll or lock individual lines in the list on the left.

    Previews on screen loop automatically.

    Green screen and black background render white text and effects over a solid color, without background patterns, paper texture, particles or vignette. The preview shows the export. Use a chroma key for green or Screen blending / a luma key for black to composite over footage.

    Export range〜
    —

    Export runs in your browser (Chrome or Edge recommended).

    Reset

    This clears everything below and starts over. It cannot be undone.

    • Lyrics, song title and artist
    • The loaded song (including the copy kept in this browser)
    • Timing, per-line settings and export range
    • Style, motion, palette, fonts and other settings
    • Variation history (◀ ▶) and the lyrics / timing undo history

    Simple / Advanced mode, preview volume and the interface language stay as they are. Saved project files (.json) are not affected.

    This is an unofficial derivative of JIZURA by hakoniwa, adapted by cityedge for subtitle layer production. The original author does not maintain this edition.

    Original JIZURA — hakoniwa

    You do not need to place this app’s MIT license notice in exported videos. Check the rights and terms of the lyrics, music, images, videos, fonts and other material you use.

    Selected media is processed in your browser and is not uploaded by the app. Settings and subtitles are autosaved in browser storage. Font loading connects to Google Fonts. Media files are not embedded in project JSON.

## Fonts (not bundled)

The web app loads the following typefaces at runtime from Google Fonts (https://fonts.google.com/); they are not
included in this repository. They are distributed by their authors under the SIL Open Font License 1.1:
Noto Sans JP, Noto Serif JP, Dela Gothic One, Zen Kaku Gothic New, Zen Old Mincho, Kaisei Tokumin,
M PLUS Rounded 1c, Mochiy Pop One, DotGothic16, Yuji Syuku, IBM Plex Mono, IBM Plex Sans JP.

Additional families requested by the current effect/language font tables (also not bundled):
Reggae One, Rampart One, Potta One, Kiwi Maru, Klee One, Shippori Mincho B1;
Noto Sans TC, Noto Serif TC, Noto Sans SC, Noto Serif SC, Noto Sans KR, Noto Serif KR;
WDXL Lubrifont TC, Chiron GoRound TC, Huninn, LXGW WenKai TC, LXGW Marker Gothic;
ZCOOL QingKe HuangYou, ZCOOL KuaiLe, ZCOOL XiaoWei, Ma Shan Zheng;
IBM Plex Sans KR, Black Han Sans, Jua, Do Hyeon, Gowun Dodum, Gowun Batang, Nanum Brush Script.
The active list is defined in `src/02_fonts.js` and `src/02b_lang.js`.
Font-specific license files are available from the Google Fonts source repository:
https://github.com/google/fonts

System fonts and fonts selected by the user are not distributed with this app and retain their own licenses.

    JIZURA Layer Studio User Guide

    Create an animated subtitle front and binary matte to composite over another video.

    1. Import subtitles

      Choose a UTF-8 SRT with “Import SRT”. Start/end times, line breaks and gaps are preserved. Use “Edit SRT text, start and end” to make changes. You can also type subtitles without an SRT.

    2. Create effects and preview

      Use Auto-compose, then adjust individual lines. Load an image or video as a preview background to check the composite. Neither the background nor the song used for timing is exported.

    3. Add a spectrum video if needed

      Load a front video. Select its matching “name_matte_dark.mp4” together with it if available. Without a matte, only RGB 000000 is transparent. Default placement is 65% of frame width, with 3% left/bottom margins. Position and horizontal/vertical scales are adjustable. Subtitles appear in front; both start at time zero.

    4. Adjust dark exterior glow

      “Exterior bloom cleanup” is below the cut list in the left pane. Its range is 0–128, default 32; zero disables cleanup. Higher values remove more dark exterior glow. Original text, graphics and sparks are protected from this cleanup.

    5. Save two MP4 files

      Select aspect ratio, resolution and fps, then “Export matte + front MP4”. Allow multiple downloads if the browser asks. Individual save links remain available if either file is missing. Both videos are silent and are downloaded without ZIP compression. Keep the tab open during export.

    6. Composite in your video editor

      Apply the matte to the background with Darken, then apply the front with Lighten. Keep both videos aligned in time and size. If using the matte as alpha, invert it so white is transparent and black is opaque.

    FPS and spectrum

    The default is 30fps. Subtitle cadence offers 15 drawings/s (on twos), 10 drawings/s (on threes), and full output fps. Saved 24fps and legacy cadences are preserved. Spectrum export selects decoded frames by presentation timestamp, independently of subtitle cadence. A constant 30fps source exported at 30fps from a source frame boundary uses each source frame once in order. 29.97fps, variable or mismatched frame rates require holds or drops. Unsupported sources report an error.

    Save and restore

    Save a project JSON with the top Save button. It preserves subtitles, effects and spectrum placement, but not the actual background, spectrum or song files. Reselect those files when reopening. Save your project before switching languages.

    Output characteristics

    Pure black in the front means empty space. Black subtitle artwork is processed as RGB 030303. Before compression, exactly the nonblack pixels in the final front have a black matte. The matte is binary, without partial transparency. MP4 compression can slightly change colours and edges.

    Desktop Chrome / Edge is recommended. MP4 export requires WebCodecs and H.264 encoding support. Long or high-resolution exports use more memory; start with a short range.

    cityedge fork · v0.9.0-layer.14
